items.title: Ralph Emerson Brown and Jasper Taylor Interview, 1961-05-23
items.q: One fellow named Big Green, Big Green's dead now

ctx.x: That isn't a union requirement, they just like to build it.

They would do it, no, that wasn't a union requirement. I mean a union requirement if you play a theater, you have so many New York bands, outside bands, that's what that is. But those people in Sephora, they would mess around with your band, and they put a few fellows with Jimmy and his band, and it didn't do the band any good. I know that, see. One fellow named Big Green, Big Green's dead now, Big Trummel, there was a hard guy to get along with Snowy. He used to work for Fletcher Henderson, a hard guy, he liked…
That was before you left New York.
